roles.title: Software Engineer
description: Took a greenfield automation platform for a major streaming customer from first design to production — architecture, PostgreSQL schema, a rules-based decision engine, Kubernetes deployment and the stakeholder conversations — and stayed its owner after the MVP through the design document, phased release plan, feature reviews and a tracked technical-debt log.
Removed the platform's main latency and database bottleneck by rebuilding its matching engine around a single indexed SQL query in place of an O(n×m) in-memory comparison.

First to act on a critical PHP remote-code-execution vulnerability (CVSS 9.2): mapped which AWS services were internet-facing, agreed the fix with senior engineers and patched seven services, three of them through one shared base image.

Led the move of production logging to native Elastic Agent across around ten services with APM instrumentation, and helped migrate production services to ARM-based Graviton, cutting their compute costs by around 20%.
Built an AWS Bedrock AgentCore proof of concept and took it to a cross-team adoption meeting and an internal tech talk; the go-to engineer across teams for AWS, Kubernetes and observability problems.

roles.title: Junior Software Engineer
description: Introduced Psalm static analysis to an existing PHP/Laravel codebase and raised it to the strictest level, while building microservices with OpenAPI-designed REST APIs and PHPUnit coverage.

Validated the whole system's deployment on EKS, tracking down integration issues across services and raising the fixes, and built the multi-stage GitLab CI/CD pipelines and Helm charts that shipped services there.
Gave a company-wide tech talk on Kubernetes and mentored junior colleagues on Kubernetes and AWS.
Promoted to Software Engineer after 16 months, against a structured set of technical objectives each backed by delivered production work.

earlier.title: Integration Engineer
earlier.summary: Full-stack React, Next.js and Python/Flask work, integrating ServiceNow, FreshService and Power Platform with Azure and GCP, and leading sprint coordination.

earlier.title: Volunteer Software Engineering Instructor
earlier.summary: Taught refugees and career-changers through class support, homework review and workshops, after graduating from the same programme in 2021.

earlier.title: Volunteer Student Mentor
earlier.summary: Mentored students on the 16-week bootcamp through technical problems and questions about getting into tech.
